name: Piña fiber handkerchief
where: Kultura, SM Makati, or SM Mall of Asia
about: Piña is a delicate cloth woven from pineapple leaf fiber, a Filipino craft long associated with Manila's fine textile tradition.
tip: Check the fiber blend and whether the embroidery is machine-made or hand-done.

name: Dried mango
about: Sweet, chewy dried mango is one of the Philippines' best-known snacks, and it is sold throughout the country.
tip: Buy it at the airport if you are short on time, since it is easy to pack for the flight home.
